name: Async using awaits an incomplete Gate and closes once on resumption

input.source_text: mut log = []; class C { public fun close() -> Nil { log.append(:closed) } } class A { public async fun f(gate: Object) -> Symbol { using(C.new()) { |r| await gate }; :done } } module M { public fun run() -> Array { let gate = Gate.new(); let task = A.new().f(gate); Gate.complete(gate, 1); [Host.run(task), log] } } M.run()
